newsitem.title: USA: Citicorp, American Express silent on rumors.
newsitem.headline: Citicorp, American Express silent on rumors.

text.p: Citicorp and American Express Co declined comment on stock market rumors that they had resumed merger talks.
"We don't comment on market rumors or speculation," said a Citicorp spokesman.
"It's our policy not to comment on market speculation or rumors," said an American Express spokeswoman.
At the Citicorp annual meeting in April, Chairman and Chief Executive John Reed confirmed that the two companies had talked but said they had failed to come to an agreement.
American Express was up 4-3/4 to 77-7/8 in afternoon trading. Citicorp was off 1/8 at 118-7/8.
Speculation about American Express being sold has focused on a price around $90 per share.
